title: Alhambra Private tour
text:
We booked a private tour of the Alhambra in Granada, and it was hands down the highlight of our trip.
Our guide, Pablo, was absolutely incredible. He was incredibly sincere, passionate, and deeply knowledgeable about the rich history and architecture of the Alhambra. Instead of just rattling off dates and facts, Pablo brought the stories of the palaces and gardens to life, answering all of our questions with genuine enthusiasm.
Having a private tour allowed us to move at our own pace and truly appreciate the beauty of the site without feeling rushed. If you are planning a visit, I highly recom

author: GretaV205

title: A Wonderful Family Tour of the Alhambra with Gema
text:
We visited the Alhambra with our two boys, aged 11 and 7, and had a wonderful guided tour with Gema.
She took us on a fascinating historical journey through the Alhambra, making it engaging and enjoyable for both children and adults. She struck the perfect balance between sharing interesting stories, allowing time to rest, and giving the kids plenty of opportunities to ask questions.
Gema was incredibly attentive, patient, and enthusiastic, always taking the children’s curiosity into account.
It was a truly memorable experience for the whole family. We highly recommend Alhambra trip Granada!
